description: The file is a PHP source file for a popup user selection interface in SuiteCRM, handling user searches, form rendering, and list view processing for selecting users.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: Class responsible for managing list view rendering and processing for the suiteCRM interface.

methods.name: setXTemplate
methods.description: Sets the XTemplate object used for rendering the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the title displayed in the list view header.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the HTML content for the list view header.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Defines the query parameters for the list view.

methods.name: setModStrings
methods.description: Sets the language strings used in the list view.

methods.name: processListViewMulti
methods.description: Processes and outputs a multi-select list view based on the query and template.
